title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: All sections: time plan, product chooser, look-alike terms and decision rules
Apply a repeatable method to every question; choose the right Google Cloud product for a business need; separate look-alike terms across the six sections
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

toc.title: Five questions to ask in every scenario

html:
1Technique

Item Advice
Time 90 minutes for 50 to 60 questions: about 90 seconds each
Order Answer the easy ones first; mark and return to hard ones
Business first Find the goal: speed, cost, scale, insight, security, trust
Eliminate Remove answers that are too technical, not Google Cloud, or do not fit the goal
Prefer Managed, serverless, scalable and least effort
Never blank Answer every question
Exam tip

. The exam tests what a product is for, not how to configure it. Learn each product in one sentence.

2The product chooser

Need Product
Store files, images, backups Cloud Storage (Standard, Nearline, Coldline, Archive, Autoclass)
Standard managed database Cloud SQL; PostgreSQL, high performance → AlloyDB
Global relational scale Spanner
Massive low-latency NoSQL Bigtable
Documents for mobile and web apps Firestore
Serverless analytics warehouse BigQuery (ML with BigQuery ML)
Self-service business intelligence Looker
Events in, processing, results out Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery
Virtual machines Compute Engine (spot VMs for cheap, interruptible work)
Containers at scale GKE; across clouds GKE Enterprise
Serverless containers / event code Cloud Run / Cloud Run functions
API management Apigee
Build agents and AI apps Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
Agents for employees Gemini Enterprise
AI infrastructure AI Hypercomputer (GPUs, TPUs)
Threat insight Google Threat Intelligence
Risk and misconfiguration Security Command Center
Detection and response Google Security Operations
Protect AI prompts and answers Model Armor
Application access without a VPN Identity-Aware Proxy
Observe systems Cloud Monitoring, Logging, Trace, Profiler, Error Reporting

3Look-alike pairs

Pair Difference
Hybrid and multicloud On-premises plus cloud and more than one cloud
Zone and region Failure domain and geographic area
IaaS, PaaS, SaaS Most control, build apps, finished software
Data warehouse and data lake Cleaned for analysis and raw, any type
Rehost and refactor Move as is and rewrite for the cloud
GKE and Cloud Run Container control and serverless containers
Authentication, authorization, auditing Who, what may you do, what did you do
SLI, SLO, SLA Measure, target, contract
Quota and budget Limit use and alert on spend
Data residency and digital sovereignty Where data is stored and who controls it under which law
Analytics, ML, gen AI, agentic AI Describes, predicts, creates, acts

4Five questions to ask in every scenario

Question Why
What is the business goal? It points to the benefit being tested
Is it data, AI, compute, security or operations? It points to the section
Which option is managed and serverless? It is often the answer
What does the product do in one sentence? It removes look-alikes
Does it follow the shared responsibility model? Data and access are always the customer's
Exam tip

. If two answers fit, pick the one with less operational work and more scale.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A candidate has 55 exam questions and 90 minutes and wants a pacing plan. What is a sensible approach?

  • AAnswer the easy questions first and mark the hard ones
  • BSpend ten minutes on every question
  • CSkip all the questions about security
  • DLeave questions blank if they seem difficult
Show the answer

Answer: A. Answer easy items first, mark hard ones and return; never leave questions blank.

S2A startup wants analytics on huge data with SQL and no servers to manage. Which choice fits best?

  • ACloud SQL, a managed relational database
  • BCompute Engine, with virtual machines
  • CCloud Run functions, for small event code
  • DBigQuery, a serverless data warehouse
Show the answer

Answer: D. BigQuery is the serverless data warehouse for SQL analytics at scale.

S3A team wants to build and govern AI agents on company data. Which product fits?

  • ACloud Interconnect
  • BSpanner
  • CCloud Armor
  • DGemini Enterprise Agent Platform
Show the answer

Answer: D. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform is the platform to build, scale and govern AI agents.

S4Which statement about shared responsibility is correct in every cloud service model?

  • AThe provider owns the customer's data
  • BThe customer secures the provider's data centers
  • CResponsibility never changes between models
  • DThe customer is responsible for its own data and access
Show the answer

Answer: D. Data and access remain the customer's responsibility in every model.

S5A retailer wants to move an application quickly with no code change. Which migration path fits?

  • ARefactor into microservices
  • BReimagine as a new AI product
  • CRehost it as it is
  • DRetire the application
Show the answer

Answer: C. Rehost moves the application as it is, which is fast and needs no code change.

S6A company wants to be told when spending reaches a share of its monthly plan and limit how much of a resource a project can use. Which two features are used?

  • AAutoclass and Cloud Storage classes
  • BBudget threshold rules and resource quota policies
  • CSLIs and SLOs for reliability
  • DModel Armor and AI Protection
Show the answer

Answer: B. Budgets alert on spending thresholds and quotas limit resource use.

5.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam?

Show the answer

90 minutes.

R2Which section is the smallest?

Show the answer

Scaling with Google Cloud operations, about 10 percent.

R3What does GKE Enterprise manage?

Show the answer

Kubernetes clusters across clouds and on-premises.

R4What does Looker provide?

Show the answer

Self-service business intelligence.

R5What does Model Armor protect?

Show the answer

AI prompts and responses.

R6What does an error budget allow?

Show the answer

The unreliability the SLO permits.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Method goal first, section, eliminate, managed and serverless, one sentence per product
Pace 90 minutes, 50 to 60 questions; easy first
Look-alikes hybrid vs multicloud, zone vs region, GKE vs Cloud Run, SLI vs SLO vs SLA
Defaults managed, scalable, least effort; customer owns data and access
